title: New publication urges skeptical approach to election information produced by artificial intelligence
hook_text: New York issues election AI guide
script:
New York Attorney General Letitia James released a guide on October sixteenth to spot election AI.
The publication urges a skeptical approach to deepfakes and false answers circulating during voting periods.
Officials recommend verifying details directly through local boards of elections before sharing any voting content.
Will you check official sources before voting?
